findings.title: Credential gate treats raw accepted inventory as authorization

A synthetic FOREIGN_DIRECT_DB_ACCESS plus SECRET_READ with empty review records returned PASS, new_public_risk=0, new_cross_domain_secret_reads=0, and material_unresolved=0.
The cited checkpoint contained 121 possible public risks, 81 ambiguous/unresolved accesses, and 155 secret reads; three production migration operations remained GENUINELY_DYNAMIC_UNRESOLVED.
findings.current_reproduction_status: SOURCE_REMEDIATION_IMPLEMENTED; raw inventory is evidence-only, all 118 current public-risk signatures, 88 ambiguity signatures, and 74 production secret-read accesses require exact independently reviewed dispositions, reviewed provider-capability accesses are source- and consumer-edge-bound with zero hash mismatches, and foreign direct secret reads fail rather than becoming authorized by review prose; exact-final-commit acceptance remains pending
remediation: Separated raw credential inventory from the public-risk, ambiguity, and cross-domain review registries and bound each registry to the exact current denominator and digest.

Required allowed classification vocabularies, resolved semantics, complete evidence, and one-to-one non-contradictory review records, including a separately committed production secret-read disposition review.

Bound each reviewed runtime-provider capability to exact provider source hashes and exact consumer edges; retained owner-internal access only where the value remains masked or its result is discarded.
Made foreign direct secret reads require a separately governed owner capability and added synthetic missing/contradictory/unresolved/public-risk/foreign-secret-read failures.
findings.production_relevance: Guards production-relevant credential reads and public serialization without disclosing secret values.
findings.closure_criterion: Every current risk signature has exactly one accepted review; material unresolved, public exposure violations, and unapproved cross-domain secret reads are zero; unreviewed synthetic access fails.
